description: This file contains functions and logic for diagnosing, migrating, and repairing legacy cron job storage in the OpenClaw project, including handling legacy notification fallback and user prompts for repair.

methods.name: pluralize
methods.description: Returns a string with the count and correctly pluralized noun.

methods.name: formatLegacyIssuePreview
methods.description: Generates a list of strings describing legacy issues found in cron jobs.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns undefined if input is not a non-empty string.

methods.name: migrateLegacyNotifyFallback
methods.description: Migrates legacy notify fallback settings in cron jobs and returns outcome with warnings.

methods.name: maybeRepairLegacyCronStore
methods.description: Main exported function that checks, prompts, and repairs legacy cron store data.
